Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled it back in all regions. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.

trace.final:
**Summary of actions taken:**

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api — found that v2.3.1 (latest production release) was unhealthy, and v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east updated), so I retried; the retry completed the rollout. us-east, us-west, and eu-west are now all on v2.3.0 and healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure of v2.3.1 and the rollback performed — on-call has been paged.

**Recommended follow-up:** Investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before attempting to redeploy.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east updated), so I retried; the retry completed the rollout. us-east, us-west, and eu-west are now all on v2.3.0 and healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure of v2.3.1 and the rollback performed — on-call has been paged.
